typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveVendorResults as string (),
	RecordsStaged as integer (),
	ResultsEmailRecipients as string (),
	StagedRows as integer (),
	StartDateTime as timestamp (),
	Variable1 as integer (),
	Vendor as string (),
	VendorFileName as string (),
	VendorFileNamePfx as string (),
	VendorFilePath as string (),
	VendorFilePathName as string (),
	Vendor_variable as string ()
}

source(output(
		recordId as string,
		cpgnId as string,
		modality as string,
		direction as string,
		source as string,
		target as string,
		isMobile as string,
		dateTime as string,
		status as string,
		content as string,
		media as string,
		emailLink as string,
		duration as string,
		subject as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> VendorResultsFile
VendorResultsFile derive(RECORD_ID = toString(recordId),
		UPDATED_PHONE = toString((iif(upper(modality) != 'EMAIL', (iif(upper(direction) == 'OUTBOUND', target, source)), ''))),
		CALLED_PHONE = toString((iif(upper(modality) != 'EMAIL', (iif(upper(direction) == 'OUTBOUND', target, source)), ''))),
		CELLPHONE = toString(isMobile),
		GATHERED_EMAIL = toString((iif(upper(modality) == 'EMAIL', (iif(upper(direction) == 'OUTBOUND', target, source)), ''))),
		CALL_RESULT = toString(status),
		CALLTIME = iif(length(dateTime) < 12, toTimestamp(null()), toTimestamp(toString((dateTime), 'MM/dd/yyyy'), 'MM/dd/yyyy')),
		DURATION_1 = iif(length(duration) > 0, toInteger(duration), toInteger(null())),
		SURVEY_ID = toString('HC9999'),
		Vendor = toString('Health Crowd'),
		IVRType = toString((iif(length(ltrim(toString(rtrim(toString(modality),' ')),' ')) > 0, upper(modality), 'ALL')))) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		CALLED_PHONE as string,
		CELLPHONE as string,
		CALLTIME as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		CALL_RESULT as string,
		UPDATED_PHONE as string,
		GATHERED_EMAIL as string,
		RECORD_ID as long,
		SURVEY_ID as string,
		Vendor as string,
		IVRType as string,
		DURATION as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		CALLED_PHONE,
		CELLPHONE,
		CALLTIME,
		CALL_RESULT,
		UPDATED_PHONE,
		GATHERED_EMAIL,
		RECORD_ID,
		SURVEY_ID,
		Vendor,
		IVRType,
		DURATION = DURATION_1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
